svg.title: Posterior arm and elbow
svg.desc: Right arm, posterior view. Left panel: deltoid and the long and lateral heads of triceps brachii converging on one tendon at the olecranon. Right panel: enlarged elbow showing the triceps tendon and the small triangular anconeus.
